nodes.text: Wow, Jessica's so much better than the last time I saw her! I'm going to need to step it up if I'm going to do the best cheer! I hope I don't forget anything!

nodes.text: We were on the same squad, so we used to hang out a lot. I always thought that she was a really great dancer.

nodes.text: How sweet!

nodes.text: Ha ha, fun!

nodes.text: Jessica, your turn. Introduce $ZOE.
Jessica turns and gives $ZOE a sugary smile.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What can I say about $ZOE? There are so many things! There was this incident with the Head Cheerleader...
$ZOE's stomach knots up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Back when $ZOE was a new student, our Head Cheerleader made $ZOE babysit a lizard for a day, and she guarded that thing like no one's business!
The other girls laugh, and $ZOE relaxes in her chair.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh... Maybe Sam was wrong. Maybe she has changed...
$ZOE contemplates not telling the girls about Jessica, but she can't keep her mouth shut.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is Jessica, and despite how she seems now, she used to be really mean and a cheater in high school. In fact, she rigged the ballots just so that her boyfriend would become president in the school election!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Gasp!
There's a shocked silence, and everyone slowly turns to Jessica. For an instant, $ZOE thinks she sees anger in Jessica's eyes, but the next moment, it's replaced by hurt. Jessica starts to sniffle.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She's right. I did that in high school. I also used to be really mean.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: But... Why?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because I wanted to date the most popular guy on campus, and I knew if he won, he'd be more popular than ever.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It was really shallow of me, but that was such a long time ago. I feel like I've changed so much since then. I used to not think about others, but I realized that I'd hurt so many people.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'd hoped the scandal wouldn't follow me... But it's hard to escape the past.

nodes.speaker: Aria
nodes.text: It's okay, Jess. We've all made mistakes. You don't have to be defined by who you were. You're with us now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica seems genuinely sad. What if Sam was wrong? Maybe she has changed...

nodes.text: Jessica, are you going to be okay?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: As long as I know people aren't going to judge me on my past...

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Of course not.

nodes.text: Let's move on to the next set of introductions, shall we?

nodes.text: I hope so. He's the sweetest guy you've ever met, and I think he kind of likes me too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Oh, hey, mind grabbing the napkins from inside the house?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure!

$ZOE tries to find a seat and snags the only empty chair... Next to Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE. Nice seeing you again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wish I could say the same.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Good afternooooooon, ladies! I'm so glad you could all make it. Lambda Omega Lambda is simply the best sorority on campus, and you can make lifelong friendships here.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: This afternoon is all about seeing if you're a good fit for our house.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: We like to elect a `Freshman Ambassador` every Admit Weekend, a new student who will be invited to live in L.O.L. house and who will have an advantage when it comes to the sorority rush at the start of the semester!
nodes.text_bbcode: We like to elect a [color=#3b78e2][i]Freshman Ambassador[/i][/color] every Admit Weekend, a new student who will be invited to live in L.O.L. house and who will have an advantage when it comes to the sorority rush at the start of the semester!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Woo!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: So today's your chance to prove you have what it takes to be in L.O.L.! L.O.L. girls are nice, cheerful, helpful, and friendly, and those are the exact qualities that we want our Freshman Ambassador to possess!

nodes.text: Exciting!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.text: All right, that wraps up your time! Let's come back together. I'll start first. My partner was Ava! Not only does Ava plan all our charity events, but she's also a prolific knitter! She often knits for charity.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Er... But you haven't even tried it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but it looks so... Green?

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Er, okay! I'm so glad?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why on earth did I say that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But really, you look nice today too.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Thanks! This outfit's new! I just bought it yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Are you trying to impress someone?
Quinn blushes.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: ...Well, there is this really cute guy. We've been hanging out a lot together lately, and he's going to be at the party tonight.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: What? Is there something on my face?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, I just... Love your salad!

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: So you're going to meet up with her?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, I want to, but I keep calling her, and she doesn't answer.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's a shame you guys turned her away yesterday...

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Rules are rules, man. You know we made a pact with the other sororities that only their recruits are allowed on fraternity turf.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I know. It just would've been nice to talk to her.

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Maybe she's not calling 'cause she wants some space.
Sean hits Rishi lightly on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: Admit Weekend can get busy. She's probably stuck with the recruiters.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: All right, Howard. Game time. We need to bounce. You got the list of potential new rushees that we found yesterday?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yep! All their names are right here on this clipboard.

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: What about the banner we're hanging on the door for the brothers' dinner tonight?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ready to fly!

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: And the rubber chickens for the super secret M.A.N. rush ceremony?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hmmm...
He moves to the closet, steps in, and hears a squeak under his foot. He lifts up a floppy fake chicken and tosses it at Rishi's face.

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Watch it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Found 'em!

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: Great. Let's go!
You are now playing as $ZOE.
Meanwhile, on the Kingston Quad...
Sam walks $ZOE to the Lambda Omega Lambda sorority house.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what's going on today? I thought you wanted to get into this L.O.L. sorority party tonight so you could see Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yep! That's the plan.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But why are you going over now?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They're having a welcome luncheon for potential freshman recruits. I'm going because I really want to join the sorority!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes. I wish you could've been at the mixer last night. The house is gorgeous, the girls are so nice and sweet, and their events and charities sound like so much fun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know I can fit in...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...As long as Jessica doesn't mess it up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, you mentioned that. What in the world is `she` doing here? I didn't peg her as the Kingston type.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, you mentioned that. What in the world is [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] doing here? I didn't peg her as the Kingston type.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't like it. Jessica's probably got it out for you ever since you exposed her as the cold-hearted witch she is.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I had to. She stuffed the ballots to rig our school's election!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And she did a bunch of other horrible things. Remember how she broke up Ben and Denni? Or how she created that stupid gossip blog?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't have to remind me. She was the one who posted pictures of Sara and Nick on that site. She's mean, and she's manipulative. Be careful.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But the other sorority girls really like her. They say she's the sweetest, coolest person they've ever met. And last night, she was very friendly to me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe she's changed.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: People don't change overnight.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, technically, it's been several months. And from what I've heard, those months at Monarch Prep weren't breezy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Still... Just watch out for yourself.
They round the corner where the sorority house stands on a hill.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Here's your stop. Good luck with the house and with Howard!
Sam hugs her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry for leaving you alone again, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Like I said, I can amuse myself. I'm just going to hang around the Quad and relax. It's a nice day out. Bye!
$ZOE walks up to the front lawn of the sorority where the L.O.L. girls are setting up a picnic.
Quinn, L.O.L.'s sorority president, is wearing a beautiful sundress. She carries a large crystal bowl of salad and several plates in her hand.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: $ZOE! You're here! That's just fantabulous!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Cute top you're wearing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I should probably say something great back!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I...

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: You can find a million girls on campus who are `special`...
nodes.text_bbcode: You can find a million girls on campus who are [color=#e23b3b][i]special[/i][/color]...

nodes.text: Rishi stops to think about that.

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Okay, maybe not.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, exactly. $ZOE's smart and pretty, but most of all, she has a really big heart. I still care about her a lot.

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: All right, man.

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: You can find a million girls on campus who are `smart.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You can find a million girls on campus who are [color=#e23b3b][i]smart.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, they wouldn't be the same as $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: Give it up, Rishi. He's hooked.

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: You can find a million girls on campus who are `hot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You can find a million girls on campus who are [color=#e23b3b][i]hot.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, they wouldn't be the same as $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: Give it up, Rishi. He's hooked.
Howard blanks and doesn't know what to say.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... She's uh... Hot?

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: You can find a million girls on campus who are `hot.`

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: You know you don't need to go all formal. It's only Admit Weekend. It's not like we have to impress the rushes or anything. `They` have to impress us.
nodes.text_bbcode: You know you don't need to go all formal. It's only Admit Weekend. It's not like we have to impress the rushes or anything. [color=#e23b3b][i]They[/i][/color] have to impress us.

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: Somehow, I don't think it's the `guys` he's trying to impress. You remember that girl yesterday?
nodes.text_bbcode: Somehow, I don't think it's the [color=#e23b3b][i]guys[/i][/color] he's trying to impress. You remember that girl yesterday?

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Which one? Quinn?

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: No, the one who tried to crash our mixer when we were guarding the gates.

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Oh yeah... Her. She's cute.

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: She's Howard's high school girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: You mean, your `ex` high school girlfriend?
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, your [color=#e23b3b][i]ex[/i][/color] high school girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes... Why?

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Is that a good idea, man? You broke up with her last semester, and it really messed you up.

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Now look at you! You're practically running the Kingston King program, and you're on track to become the M.A.N. fraternity president!

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: You've got girls surrounding you. Why her?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, $ZOE is...
Howard puts on the periwinkle tie.
Howard puts on the duck tie.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nice ducks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Baby ducks, to be exact.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I remember that one time when you stopped our car to help that mother duck and her ducklings cross the street...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They needed help!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You held up traffic for like ten minutes!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, they needed help `and` a tiny... Duckdog.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, they needed help [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] a tiny... Duckdog.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A duckdog?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, a dog that herds ducks of course...

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: She overcame her past to become a really `nice` girl...
nodes.text_bbcode: She overcame her past to become a really [color=#3b78e2][i]nice[/i][/color] girl...

nodes.text: $ZOE runs, not knowing what her plan is or what exactly O.M.G. did to the cake.
She flies through the open door to the backyard and rushes to the patio. Quinn, Ava, and Aria come running after her!
When $ZOE is far enough away from the house, she stops and stares the other girls down.

nodes.speaker: Aria
nodes.text: She has the cake! Get her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait! Don't come closer! I saw three O.M.G. girls get in through the gate, and I think they've done something to the cake!

nodes.speaker: Aria
nodes.text: Oh yeah? They did? Because you're the one who's holding it right--
`BOOM!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]BOOM![/b]

nodes.text: Aria is cut off by a small explosion! The cake suddenly blows up all over $ZOE, covering her with colorful buttercream frosting and chunks of white cake!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahhhhh!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Oh, no, $ZOE! Are you okay?
$ZOE drops the remainder of the cake and starts swiping at the mess on her hair and face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Other than the buttercream in my ear, I think so...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: What? What happened?!
Aria's eyes narrow.

nodes.speaker: Aria
nodes.text: `O.M.G.` happened. This prank has their name all over it.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O.M.G.[/i][/color] happened. This prank has their name all over it.

nodes.speaker: Aria
nodes.text: Those guys just never stop!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: At least their plan didn't work.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry I didn't save the cake in time...

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Hey, you saved us from a very sticky situation...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Yeah! If you hadn't taken it outside, it would've exploded all over everyone at the party!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: You have our thanks.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're welcome!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Now come on, I have a towel for you in the kitchen.
A few minutes later, Quinn and a somewhat cleaner $ZOE walk into the den where everyone else is waiting. Quinn clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Hey everyone, I know we've just seen some excitement, but back to what I was saying before... It's about time we chose the Freshman Ambassador.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: I said earlier that L.O.L. girls are nice, cheerful, helpful, and friendly.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: And tonight... `Jessica` exemplified all of those traits.
nodes.text_bbcode: And tonight... [color=#3b78e2][i]Jessica[/i][/color] exemplified all of those traits.

nodes.text: Whatever trick the O.M.G. girls were planning, it's clear that it went off successfully.
And in her heart, $ZOE knows that...
She has failed.

nodes.text: $ZOE grabs the baseball and hurls it at the window!
The glass shatters and breaks into several pieces!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ah!
$ZOE positions herself to jump out the window but realizes she can't! Jagged edges of the glass are stuck in the window pane.
When she tries to push pieces of glass out, she cuts her hand deeply!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! Ow!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I should've been more careful. I can't climb out the window like this...
And then $ZOE's thoughts are distracted by a scream and several shouts from the kitchen below...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Quinn!

nodes.speaker: Aria
nodes.text: Oh no!
Ava tugs back harder! The tug-of-war keeps going until Ava pulls back so hard, $ZOE loses her grip on the cake! The cakes flies straight into Ava's face!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Ack!
Ava swipes at her face.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Ahhhh! You! There's `frosting` everywhere, and the cake... It's a mess!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ahhhh! You! There's [color=#3b78e2][i]frosting[/i][/color] everywhere, and the cake... It's a mess!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: You totally ruined this special L.O.L. tradition! I don't care what Quinn says. I want you out! Now!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... But...
At Ava's hard look, $ZOE trudges outside. When she reaches the edge of the grass, she can hear screams from the kitchen of the sorority!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Quinn! Ava! Aria!
$ZOE slaps lightly at Ava's hands. Ava draws them back in surprise.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Why... Why did you do that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry!
$ZOE grabs the cake and runs outside!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Hey wait up!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I swear, I'll explain! But not right now!
$ZOE doesn't know what to do! She tugs hard at the tray!
$ZOE ties the banner securely to a bookshelf bracketed into the wall. She throws the other end of the banner outside...
...And successfully uses it to get down to the lawn below!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where did Hayley go?!
$ZOE runs around to the backyard and finds the door to the kitchen unlocked. Three shadowy figures run away into the night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The kitchen?
She steps inside the kitchen. Everything looks untouched and pristine. Nothing seems out of order...
Then $ZOE sees the special L.O.L. sorority house cake on the table... And she knows.
$ZOE runs for it. She's just grabbed one edge of the cake when Ava enters the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: What are you doing, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll explain in a second!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: No, you'll explain `now.` We need that cake! Quinn's going to announce the Freshman Ambassador! And where have you been all evening?
nodes.text_bbcode: No, you'll explain [color=#3b78e2][i]now.[/i][/color] We need that cake! Quinn's going to announce the Freshman Ambassador! And where have you been all evening?

nodes.text: $ZOE moves to grab the cake but before she can lift it, Ava puts her hands on the cake tray.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Those are secure, right?
She climbs out the window and eases herself onto the roof. She carefully grabs hold of the second 'L' and puts her entire weight on it!
`CRACK!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]CRACK![/b]

nodes.text: The wooden letter splinters, and $ZOE falls a story into thorny bushes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ow, ow, ow...
This attracts the attention of the girls from L.O.L.! Ava and Aria rush out the front door.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: $ZOE! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Aria
nodes.text: And why are we suddenly in the `L.O.` house?
nodes.text_bbcode: And why are we suddenly in the [color=#3b78e2][i]L.O.[/i][/color] house?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can explain...

nodes.speaker: Aria
nodes.text: No, you can't. I don't know what's gotten into you. First, you don't show up for the party, and now you're ruining our house?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: We're going to have to ask you to leave!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, but listen, something's...
They're cut off by a scream from the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Quinn!
$ZOE decides to try her luck with the L.O.L. letters on the house.
$ZOE grabs the screwdriver and uses its flat side to pry up the old window.
With one loud groan, the window pane falls away onto $ZOE! She catches it and lays it on the floor.
She starts yelling out the window.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Help! Help! O.M.G.'s going to pull a prank on us!
But the music's so loud that no one can hear her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've got to get down there! But how?
Outside, the large 'L.O.L.' letters that are secured to the roof of the sorority house catch $ZOE's eye.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I could get on the roof and jump for one of those letters. If I hang off them, the fall isn't so bad...
$ZOE looks around the room and sees a huge 'Lambda Omega Lambda' banner stored in the closet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or I could tie this L.O.L. banner to something and climb down...
Unsure what to grab, $ZOE reaches her hand out blindly! The baseball rolls into her open palm when she taps the shelf.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Ducks! They're so cute! It just shows what a great sense of humor you have.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's stuck good and tight. I'm not getting out of here this way...
$ZOE spies the window on the opposite side of the room. She tries it as well, but it's jammed shut, and the lock is rusty.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What did Jessica say she used to get out? A popsicle stick, a pen, and a stick of gum?
She looks around the room and sees a broken pen on the ground.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great. I'm halfway to being only a third of the way there...
Downstairs, the L.O.L. girls and their recruits are enjoying the party!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Aria, you were the one who did all the decorations down here, weren't you?

nodes.speaker: Aria
nodes.text: Yep!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, your taste in throw pillows is ridiculously cute! You have to help `me` decorate sometime!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, your taste in throw pillows is ridiculously cute! You have to help [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] decorate sometime!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And Ava, not everyone can pull off the sunglasses look. But you do it so stylishly!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: That's why I have a million of these in my room!
Quinn comes up to them.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Have you guys seen $ZOE? She's been missing...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, after we got the supplies, she told me she needed some air. I saw her take off outside...

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: But that was thirty minutes ago...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: From what I remember from high school, $ZOE's very shy. Big parties kind of freak her out.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Hmmm, well, that doesn't seem very friendly.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And `friendly` is a core L.O.L. trait!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]friendly[/i][/color] is a core L.O.L. trait!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Too bad... I really liked her. Maybe I should track her down anyway...
But any thought of going to $ZOE disappears when the front door suddenly bursts open, and several of the M.A.N. fraternity brothers rush in!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! M.A.N. is here!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Ha ha...

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: Who brought the party? We brought the party!

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Consider it brung!

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Brang?

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Whatever. We're here!
As the other guys settle in, Quinn makes a beeline for Howard's group.

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Hey, Quinn!
Quinn nods at him and smiles sunnily at Howard.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Hi, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hi, Quinn, it's good to see you.
They hug and separate. To the side, Rishi sulks.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: It's so nice to see you too! I `love` your tie!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's so nice to see you too! I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] your tie!

nodes.text: It doesn't budge!
Daunted, $ZOE sinks to the floor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I misjudged her after all...
Quinn pops her head into the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: $ZOE, Jessica, can I ask you a favor? I have to stay down here to make sure the DJ sets everything up correctly, but I need some items for the ceremony.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: They're in a box in the upstairs closet. Would you two mind grabbing it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course not!
Jessica and $ZOE start up the stairs and down the hall.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm so excited about this party tonight.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too! Why are you excited?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because I really love this house and the girls here. It's nice to spend time with them.
$ZOE smiles.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, Jessica, I was totally wrong about you. I'm so sorry about how I've been acting today.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You really have turned over a new leaf.
They come to the closet. $ZOE walks inside, flipping on the lights.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I really hope that we can get to be good friends now that we're in college.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Oh` yeah.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oh[/i][/color] yeah.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, do you see the box Quinn asked us to find?
From the doorway, Jessica finds a small box of supplies. She picks it up and looks inside.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great, we can just--
But before $ZOE can get to the door, Jessica slams it in her face! $ZOE hears the sound of a lock turning.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica! Come on! Let me out!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sorry, $ZOE. You were probably right not to trust me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But look on the bright side. At least we won't have to see each other too much next year...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because `I'll` be living at L.O.L., and you'll be living... Well, from what I've heard about the freshman dorms, get used to your current surroundings.
nodes.text_bbcode: Because [color=#3b78e2][i]I'll[/i][/color] be living at L.O.L., and you'll be living... Well, from what I've heard about the freshman dorms, get used to your current surroundings.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Jessica!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Jessica![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE tries the door handle, pushing the door...
But it won't open!
She puts her hand on the door, braces herself, and...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll stick with vanilla. It's classic.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right. Fine. Don't believe me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I really don't know any peanut butter recipes.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, it's okay. I tried to do you a favor because we should be friends, but if you don't want my advice...
They lapse into silence while they both bake cupcakes.
An hour later, $ZOE pipes the white sugared topping into perfect swirls atop her desserts.
Ava steps in and sniffs the air. She squeals with delight.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: What are you two baking?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My classic chocolate cupcakes with vanilla frosting.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Yum!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I made these delicious peanut butter cupcakes with chocolate frosting.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Oh wow, you put `peanut butter` in yours? Aria! Come here! Jessica made `peanut butter` cupcakes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh wow, you put [color=#3b78e2][i]peanut butter[/i][/color] in yours? Aria! Come here! Jessica made [color=#3b78e2][i]peanut butter[/i][/color] cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Aria
nodes.text: Peanut butter? Can I get a sample?
They fawn over Jessica's cupcakes, eventually deciding to share one.

nodes.speaker: Aria
nodes.text: Mmmmm....

nodes.speaker: Zoe

Which worked really well last time.

Aria and Ava push her towards the kitchen.
Tonight's the night! I'm going to ask him out!
She swings into the kitchen and nearly trips when she sees Howard sweep $ZOE into a romantic kiss!
She falls back against the wall and frowns, piecing things together.
The girl Howard was looking for earlier wasn't Jessica...
And later that night, an hour after the L.O.L. party ends...
Jessica leaves the dorms and walks to a cafe a couple blocks off campus.
She slips into a booth in the back where a girl is sipping a milkshake.
I was at a party if you `recall.`
Yeah. About that. Why didn't our cake thing work?
You were supposed to make sure it went perfectly!
My only job was to make sure that you got into the kitchen.
The rest of it isn't my fault.
I couldn't have predicted that some psycho goody-goody was going to run outside with the cake and ruin the plan!
I trusted you to get it done.
Well, you know what? I got something better. While everyone was distracted by that little prank you were pulling, I succeeded at something amazing.
Quinn made me the Freshman Ambassador! So it doesn't matter that this prank failed tonight...
What exactly is Jessica up to? And can Quinn get over the fact that $ZOE and Howard are together?
Looks like $ZOE's going to have a very interesting semester when the school year at Kingston officially starts!
